sources.title: Gemma 4 — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Safety Gemma 4 models undergo the same rigorous infrastructure security protocols as our proprietary models. By choosing Gemma 4, enterprises and sovereign organizations gain a trusted, transparent foundation that delivers state-of-the-art capabilities while meeting the highest standards for security and reliability.

sources.title: majentik/gemma-4-E2B-it-TurboQuant-MLX-4bit · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 4-bit weight-quantized MLX version of google/gemma-4-E2B-it with the legacy TurboQuant KV-cache fork (superseded by upstream llama.cpp KV options). Optimized for Apple Silicon inference via the MLX framework.

sources.title: Gemma 4 | Google AI Edge | Google for Developers
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 models are designed to deliver frontier-level performance at each size, targeting deployment scenarios from mobile and edge devices (E2B, E4B) to consumer GPUs and workstations (26B A4B, 31B). They are well-suited for reasoning, agentic workflows, coding, and multimodal understanding.

sources.title: Gemma 4 E2B — Ultra-Lightweight Local AI | gemma4.dev
sources.snippet: Models /Gemma 4 E2B Gemma 4 E2B — Ultra-Lightweight Local AI Gemma 4 E2B packs 2.1 billion parameters into the smallest footprint in the Gemma 4 family. Text-only, 8K context, and capable of running entirely on CPU — making it the go-to model for edge devices, embedded systems, and ultra-low-latency applications.

sources.title: Gemma 4 model card | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: The models are available in five distinct sizes: E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B A4B, and 31B. Their diverse sizes make them deployable in environments ranging from high-end phones to laptops and servers, democratizing access to state-of-the-art AI.
